name: Arturo Flores
office: City of Huntington Park, Member of the City Council, 5th District

items.text: Arturo Flores has served on the Huntington Park City Council since September 2022. He is a Marine Corps combat veteran who deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. He called for an investigation into the city's aquatics center after $9 million was paid to a contractor with no work done. In June 2025, he condemned immigration raids by masked individuals in unmarked vehicles, urging police to enforce vehicle identification laws.

sentences.text: Arturo Flores has served on the Huntington Park City Council since September 2022.
He is a Marine Corps combat veteran who deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan.
He called for an investigation into the city's aquatics center after $9 million was paid to a contractor with no work done.
In June 2025, he condemned immigration raids by masked individuals in unmarked vehicles, urging police to enforce vehicle identification laws.

items.text: The council censured him in April 2026 for misconduct; he called the censure political theater. He resigned as mayor in January 2026 to focus on fighting a recall attempt.
